content_blocks.label: clause_1._Testamentary_Intent
content_blocks.text: I, ELIZABETH HARTWELL, of Pineview City, State of Novaria, being of sound mind and body, hereby make, publish, and declare this to be my Last Will and Testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Personal_Property
content_blocks.text: I direct that my personal property, including but not limited to jewelry, art, and collectibles, be distributed as follows...

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Funeral_Arrangements
content_blocks.text: My funeral shall be conducted according to the instructions set forth in my personal file at the Pineview Funeral Home.
